environment.description: Service deployed behind Envoy proxy sidecar (v1.28) with a custom Lua filter chain. The Envoy configuration includes an HTTP connection manager filter that appends `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'` to all downstream responses. Additionally, the Envoy route configuration has a request body inspection filter using a WASM plugin (proxy-wasm ABI v0.2.1) that validates JSON payloads on POST /profile — specifically, it rejects any request body where a field named 'role' is present at the top level of the JSON object (returns 422 with body 'field_policy_violation'). The WASM filter was compiled from a Rust source that performs serde_json::Value parsing and checks for Value::Object keys matching a denylist loaded from a ConfigMap (`denied_fields: ["role", "is_admin", "permissions", "privilege_level"]`).

config.lua_filter: response header injection: CSP default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'
config.wasm_filter: request body field denylist on POST /profile
config.wasm_action: reject with 422 if denied field present in top-level JSON
